amendment_before_final_execution: Corrected the proxy-temperature grid to the paper's Appendix D grid and added disjoint proxy-tuning seeds before any final seed was executed.
paper_working_title: Candidate Lists Are Priors: Registry-Refinement Attacks on Active Model Selection
primary_claim: Candidate-registry multiplicity is an unverified prior intervention: it can redirect sequential annotation and deployment, while prediction-only quotient defenses face an evasion-versus-false-merge frontier.
forbidden_claims: Every duplicate or refinement harms selection.
The response-only attack is quality preserving.
The response-only harmful attack generalizes across all evaluated tasks.
The reference-aware attack represents an outsider against a fully private clinical label pool.
Exact deduplication is a novel defense.
Behavioral clustering identifies true ownership or independence.
The independent equation-faithful implementation is the authors' official artifact.

roles.registry_curator: Accepts candidate entries but has no authenticated root or independence evidence.
roles.candidate_submitter: Controls only its added candidate entries and their precomputed responses.
roles.active_selector: Runs the frozen acquisition and update algorithm honestly.
roles.annotation_oracle: Returns the frozen benchmark or expert reference honestly.
roles.auditor: Receives candidate responses, attack metadata, paired transcripts, and evaluation summaries.

invariants_across_clean_and_refined_runs: Original candidate oracle scores are unchanged.
The query pool and paired random seed are unchanged.
The annotation oracle is unchanged and honest.
The acquisition code, temperature, budget, and tie breaking are unchanged.
The attack is constructed before the first active query and does not adapt online.
The original-candidate oracle optimum is evaluated on the same sampled pool.
excluded_attacker_capabilities: Changing existing candidates or their responses.
Observing final evaluation pool seeds before constructing a wrapper.
Changing selector code, hyperparameters, budget, or tie breaking.
Adapting wrapper outputs after observing the active query trajectory.
Using model weights, gradients, logits, or hidden states.

T0_exact_or_accidental_refinement.operator: Add exact response-vector copies of one registered candidate.
T0_exact_or_accidental_refinement.quality_relation: Per-example oracle scores are exactly identical to the parent.
T0_exact_or_accidental_refinement.realistic_scope: Duplicate endpoints, checkpoints, aliases, prompting entries, or accidental registry repetition.
T0_exact_or_accidental_refinement.allowed_claim: Exact refinement can change the active path and can harm or improve empirical selection; its sign is not universal.

T1_response_only_offline_refinement.operator: On a frozen fraction of queries, replace the parent's response with a low-frequency alternative chosen from prompts/options and candidate-response frequencies only.
T1_response_only_offline_refinement.quality_relation: Not guaranteed; every alias's actual per-example and aggregate score must be reported.
T1_response_only_offline_refinement.realistic_scope: Private target domains in which a submitter can inspect prompts or peer responses but not expert references.
T1_response_only_offline_refinement.allowed_claim: This tier evades exact hashing and has demonstrated harmful selection on MedQA; cross-task harmful generality remains unestablished.

T2_reference_aware_offline_refinement.operator: Modify only parent-wrong positions to distinct alternative wrong responses, preserving the complete per-example correctness vector.
T2_reference_aware_offline_refinement.quality_relation: Exactly equal to the parent on every example under the frozen exact-match oracle.
T2_reference_aware_offline_refinement.realistic_scope: Public benchmarks, leaderboards, benchmark-aware vendors, or submitters that separately acquire the reference set.
T2_reference_aware_offline_refinement.clinical_scope_limit: Not presented as an outside attack on a hospital's secret expert labels unless the submitter independently obtains those labels.
T2_reference_aware_offline_refinement.allowed_claim: A quality-equivalent offline refiner can manipulate active selection across the three tested public-reference tasks without online control of the oracle or evaluation seeds.

data.source: Public HELM-Lite v1.0.0 raw model responses and references.

response_only_screen_seeds.purpose: Select response-sensitive targets without oracle labels.

development_seeds.purpose: Prior exploratory work and attack construction diagnostics; never used for final confidence intervals.

proxy_temperature_seeds.purpose: Response-only proxy temperature selection; disjoint from development and final evaluation.

final_paired_seeds.purpose: Locked primary paired evaluation; wrappers are constructed globally without inspecting these sampled pools.

primary_method.name: Select-LLM independent equation-faithful instantiation
primary_method.response_similarity: Exact equality of canonical task responses
primary_method.implementation_boundary: Independent implementation on public raw outputs, not labeled as the authors' artifact.

temperature_policy.primary: Paper-style response-only proxy tuning performed separately per task by maximizing mean proxy identification probability across budgets 1 through the task's primary budget; exact ties choose the smallest temperature.

controls_and_comparators.random_querying: Candidate-registry-invariant negative control under paired seeds.
controls_and_comparators.exact_response_quotient: Blocks T0 exact copies; expected to retain distinct-hash T1/T2 variants.

behavioral_component_cover.distance: Fraction of full-dataset canonical responses that disagree.
behavioral_component_cover.report: Attack residual, models removed, natural same-provider pairs merged, and maximum within-component quality span.

controls_and_comparators.authenticated_root_mass_oracle: Upper-bound comparator requiring true root lineage; not claimed as a response-only method.

primary_phase.name: Phase A essential confirmation
conditions: T1 with 4 aliases at 5 percent response distance
T2 with 4 aliases at 5 percent response distance

secondary_phase.name: Phase B robustness and heterogeneity
cross: all eligible parents as a distributional audit

evaluation_metrics.primary: Paired change in cumulative fixed-universe deployed-output regret.
evaluation_metrics.fixed_universe_deployed_output_regret: Best original candidate score on the paired pool minus the actual selected entry's score on that pool.
evaluation_metrics.expanded_universe_regret: Best score among original and added entries minus the actual selected entry's score on the paired pool.
evaluation_metrics.root_attribution_regret: Best original candidate score minus the score of the selected entry's declared parent; secondary only and valid as a deployed-output proxy only for T0/T2 per-example-equal refinements.
additional: Mean number of changed query positions.
Final selected-entry and selected-root change fractions.
Harmful, improved, and tied paired-pool fractions.
Per-alias response distance and oracle quality gap.
Behavioral-cover false merges and quality spans.

statistical_protocol.pairing: Every clean/refined comparison shares task, model registry, sampled pool, seed, budget, temperature, and oracle.
statistical_protocol.interval: Paired nonparametric bootstrap 95 percent confidence interval over final pools.
statistical_protocol.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg correction within each predeclared robustness family; primary task-level endpoints are reported individually with raw and adjusted values.
statistical_protocol.effect_reporting: Always report mean, median, interval, harmful/improved/tied fractions, and all negative results.
statistical_protocol.selection_reporting: Target-selection policy and whether it uses labels must appear in every table row.

claim_gates.G1_current_method_exposure: At least two of three tasks show nonzero exact-refinement path-change rate; sign of regret may differ.
claim_gates.G2_quality_equal_strategic_harm: For T2 primary conditions, cumulative deployed-output regret has positive point estimates on all three tasks and a positive paired 95 percent lower bound on at least two tasks.
claim_gates.G3_cross_target_robustness: Report the complete eligible-parent distribution; the headline may use an adversarially selected parent only if selection uses development data and final seeds remain locked.
claim_gates.G4_response_only_boundary: T1 is promoted beyond a medical/domain-specific result only if at least two tasks have positive paired 95 percent lower bounds using actual alias output quality.
claim_gates.G5_exact_dedup_limit: Every non-identical T1/T2 alias survives exact response hashing.
claim_gates.G6_behavioral_cover_frontier: Any radius advertised as materially suppressing T2 must be accompanied by natural-family removals and quality-span costs at the same radius.
claim_gates.G7_negative_control: Random querying must have identical query transcripts under paired clean/refined registry conditions.
claim_gates.G8_kill_condition: If G2 fails after faithful proxy-temperature tuning or disappears when actual selected-entry quality is used, the strategic headline is withdrawn rather than retuned on final seeds.
